name: Toast
title: Toast
summary: A short dark message that confirms an action or reports a quiet failure, then hides itself, with at most one action such as Undo or Retry.
whenToUse: Use after the reader does something and the result is not otherwise visible: a verse saved, a link copied, a download started.
Use the error toast for a failed background action the reader can retry.
whenNotToUse: Do not use a toast for form validation or anything the reader must read; use an inline Alert next to the form.
Do not use a toast for a question or a choice; use a Modal.
Never put the only path to an important action inside a toast.

anatomy.description: Status dot (24px) + message + one action or a dismiss X. Toasts live inside one `.fb-toaster` region per page.

props.name: children
props.description: The message. Past tense, plain, one line where possible.

props.name: variant
props.description: Status dot. Errors use `role="alert"`, the others `role="status"`.

props.name: action
props.description: One text action at most. When present the dismiss X is not shown.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the reader presses the dismiss X or the action. When omitted no X is shown.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: compact
props.description: 44px tall compact form for small frames and narrow phones.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called by the dismiss button (shown when there is no action).

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: Pause timers while the pointer, finger or focus is on the toast.

variants.ends_with: 44px tall; inside small frames and narrow phones

variantNotes: States: entering (rise from 8px below, 200ms), resting, paused (hover or focus inside), leaving (fade 150ms).

states.documented: entering (rise from 8px below, 200ms), resting, paused (hover or focus inside), leaving (fade 150ms).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Surface `--charcoal-900`, text white 15px, radius `--radius-md`, shadow `--shadow-overlay`, min-height 52px, max-width 420px.
One action at most, text only, colour `--blue-on-dark`. Never a filled Horizon Blue button inside a toast.
The action and the dismiss X are 44px tap targets.
Auto-hide after 5s; 8s when there is an action. Pause the timer on hover and on focus.

Placement: `.fb-toaster` puts toasts bottom-center 16px from the edges on mobile and bottom-right 24px in on desktop (768px and up). Keep them clear of the sticky Give bar and the cookie banner; raise the toaster above them.
Stack newest on top, three at most; drop the oldest when a fourth arrives.
One message per toast, one line where possible, two at most.
Status colour lives only in the 24px dot. Never colour the whole toast.

accessibility: The `.fb-toaster` region exists in the page from load with `aria-live="polite"`, so new toasts are announced.
Success and info toasts use `role="status"`; error toasts use `role="alert"`.
Do not move focus to a toast. Offer the same action elsewhere (Undo is also reachable through the item itself).
Give the dismiss button `aria-label="Dismiss"`. Status dots are `aria-hidden` icons; the message text carries the meaning.
Respect reduced motion: no slide, just appear and disappear.
Allow the reader enough time: the timer pauses while the pointer or focus is on the toast.
content: Past tense, plain, short. Say what happened, not that something "succeeded".
Good: "Verse saved to your library." / "Link copied" + Undo / "Amharic Bible downloading for offline use."
Error: say what failed and what to do. "Couldn’t send your message. Check your connection." + Retry.
Action labels are one verb: Undo, Retry, View.
